datasets.name: ds_p0_kpi
queryLines:
WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1),
f AS (SELECT SUM(total_with_headroom_usd) AS fy_base_usd FROM v_fy_forecast_total WHERE scenario = 'Base')
SELECT c.month AS ref_month, c.total_today_usd, c.total_post_promo_usd, c.total_post_promo_usd / NULLIF(c.total_today_usd, 0) AS multiplier, f.fy_base_usd
FROM c CROSS JOIN f

datasets.name: ds_p1_price
queryLines:
SELECT srti_sku, sku_source, srti_list_price, srti_net_price, srti_net_price_with_addon, contract_discount_srti,
       addon_uplift, free_allowance_dbus, free_allowance_dbus * srti_list_price AS allowance_value_usd
FROM v_price

datasets.name: ds_p1_skus
queryLines:
SELECT sku_name, cloud, CASE WHEN billed_by_genie THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não (outro produto)' END AS billed_by_genie, last_usage_date
FROM agg_srti_skus ORDER BY billed_by_genie DESC, last_usage_date DESC, sku_name

datasets.name: ds_p1_obs
queryLines:
WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM v_price),
s AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_name) AS n FROM agg_srti_skus WHERE billed_by_genie)
,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('SKU que será aplicado a Genie Agents e Genie One a partir de 01/02/2027: ', COALESCE(p.srti_sku, 'nenhum SKU SRTI encontrado'), ' (origem: ', COALESCE(p.sku_source, 'n/d'), ').') AS observacao FROM p
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ordem, concat('Preço de lista: US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(p.srti_list_price AS DOUBLE), 4), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '/DBU. Com desconto contratual de ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (p.contract_discount_srti) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' e adicional de plataforma de ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (p.addon_uplift) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ', o preço líquido usado em toda a previsão é US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(p.srti_net_price_with_addon AS DOUBLE), 4), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '/DBU.') AS observacao FROM p
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat('A franquia de ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(p.free_allowance_dbus AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs vale ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(p.free_allowance_dbus * p.srti_list_price AS DOUBLE), 2), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ' por usuário/mês a preço de lista. A franquia não é afetada pelo desconto contratual.') AS observacao FROM p
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ordem, CASE WHEN s.n > 1 THEN concat(s.n, ' SKUs SRTI são faturados pelo Genie na conta, ou seja, há workspaces em várias regiões. O modelo usa um único preço (o SKU mais recente). Para precisão por região, filtre workspace_ids por região.') WHEN s.n = 1 THEN 'Um único SKU SRTI é faturado pelo Genie na conta: o preço acima vale para todo o uso.' ELSE 'O Genie ainda não fatura nenhum SKU SRTI na conta: o preço vem do SKU SRTI usado por outro produto de IA da mesma conta.' END AS observacao FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ordem, CASE WHEN p.contract_discount_srti = 0 THEN 'O desconto contratual está em 0% (preço de lista). Peça ao time comercial o desconto do SKU SRTI e atualize forecast_assumptions.contract_discount_srti.' ELSE concat('Desconto contratual configurado: ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (p.contract_discount_srti) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), '. Confirme com o time comercial que ele vale para o SKU SRTI.') END AS observacao FROM p),
wrapped AS (SELECT ordem, observacao, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(concat('• ', observacao), '(.{1,88})(\\s+|$)', '$1\n   '), '\n   $', '') AS texto FROM o WHERE observacao IS NOT NULL),
lines_ AS (SELECT *, size(split(texto, '\\n')) AS n_lines FROM wrapped)
SELECT ordem, observacao, texto, (COALESCE(SUM(n_lines) OVER (ORDER BY ordem ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) * 19
       + (ordem - 1) * 10) AS y_px
FROM lines_ ORDER BY ordem

datasets.name: ds_p2
queryLines:
SELECT month, surface, identity_type, channel, free_dbus, billed_dbus, full_rate_dbus, identities
FROM v_monthly_baseline WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_p2_fb
queryLines:
SELECT month, 'Gratuito hoje (GENIE_FREE_USAGE)' AS sku_type, SUM(free_dbus) AS dbus
FROM v_monthly_baseline WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) GROUP BY month
UNION ALL SELECT month, 'Faturado hoje (SRTI, com 25% off)', SUM(billed_dbus)
FROM v_monthly_baseline WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_p2_kpi
datasets.displayName: Passo 2 — KPIs do mês de referência
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
b AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_monthly_baseline v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),
i AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(full_rate_dbus) FROM b) AS total_dbus,
       (SELECT SUM(free_dbus) FROM b WHERE surface IN ('GENIE_AGENTS', 'GENIE_ONE') AND identity_type = 'HUMANO') AS free_agents_one_dbus,
       (SELECT SUM(billed_dbus) FROM b WHERE identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL') AS sp_billed_dbus,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(identity_type = 'HUMANO') FROM i) AS humans,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL') FROM i) AS sps

datasets.name: ds_p2_obs
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
b AS (SELECT SUM(full_rate_dbus) AS tot, SUM(CASE WHEN surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS' THEN full_rate_dbus END) AS ag, SUM(CASE WHEN surface = 'GENIE_ONE' THEN full_rate_dbus END) AS one, SUM(CASE WHEN surface = 'GENIE_CODE' THEN full_rate_dbus END) AS code, SUM(CASE WHEN surface IN ('GENIE_AGENTS', 'GENIE_ONE') AND identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN free_dbus END) AS free_ao, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' THEN billed_dbus END) AS sp_billed, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'API' THEN full_rate_dbus END) AS api FROM v_monthly_baseline v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),
bp AS (SELECT SUM(full_rate_dbus) AS tot FROM v_monthly_baseline v JOIN ref ON v.month = add_months(ref.m, -1)),
n AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL') AS sps FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m)
,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('Em ', date_format(ref.m, 'MM/yyyy'), ', o Genie consumiu ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(b.tot AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs (taxa cheia): Genie Agents ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (b.ag / b.tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ', Genie One ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (b.one / b.tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' e Genie Code ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (b.code / b.tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), '.') AS observacao FROM b CROSS JOIN ref
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ordem, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(b.free_ao AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs de Genie Agents e Genie One usados por pessoas foram gratuitos (GENIE_FREE_USAGE). É esse volume que passa a ser cobrável, acima da franquia, a partir de 01/02/2027.') AS observacao FROM b
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat('Service principals já tiveram ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(b.sp_billed AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs faturados no mês (', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(n.sps AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' identidades). Isso já é custo hoje: SPs não têm franquia nem gratuidade.') AS observacao FROM b CROSS JOIN n
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ordem, concat('O canal API (apps, integrações, MCP) respondeu por ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (b.api / b.tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' dos DBUs. O restante veio da interface do Genie (UI).') AS observacao FROM b
UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ordem, concat('Variação do consumo total de DBUs em relação ao mês anterior: ', concat(CASE WHEN (b.tot / bp.tot - 1) >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (b.tot / bp.tot - 1) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%')), '. Com poucos meses de histórico, use essa tendência só para calibrar os cenários do Passo 7.') AS observacao FROM b CROSS JOIN bp),
wrapped AS (SELECT ordem, observacao, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(concat('• ', observacao), '(.{1,88})(\\s+|$)', '$1\n   '), '\n   $', '') AS texto FROM o WHERE observacao IS NOT NULL),
lines_ AS (SELECT *, size(split(texto, '\\n')) AS n_lines FROM wrapped)
SELECT ordem, observacao, texto, (COALESCE(SUM(n_lines) OVER (ORDER BY ordem ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) * 19
       + (ordem - 1) * 10) AS y_px
FROM lines_ ORDER BY ordem

datasets.name: ds_p3
queryLines:
SELECT month, identity_type, identities, gross_dbus, billable_dbus_post_promo, cost_today_usd, cost_post_promo_usd, humans_above_allowance
FROM v_post_promo_simulation WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY month, identity_type

datasets.name: ds_p3_cost
queryLines:
SELECT month, '1. Custo de LLM hoje (regras atuais)' AS basis, SUM(cost_today_usd) AS usd
FROM v_post_promo_simulation WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) GROUP BY month
UNION ALL SELECT month, '2. Mesmo uso com as regras de fev/2027', SUM(cost_post_promo_usd)
FROM v_post_promo_simulation WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_p3_dbus
queryLines:
SELECT month, '1. DBUs brutos (taxa cheia)' AS kind, gross_dbus AS dbus
FROM v_post_promo_simulation WHERE identity_type = 'HUMANO' AND month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month)
UNION ALL SELECT month, '2. DBUs cobráveis após a franquia', billable_dbus_post_promo
FROM v_post_promo_simulation WHERE identity_type = 'HUMANO' AND month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_p3_kpi
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m), s AS (SELECT SUM(cost_today_usd) AS today, SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS post, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' THEN cost_post_promo_usd END) AS sp_post, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN identities END) AS humans, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN humans_above_allowance END) AS above, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN gross_dbus END) AS h_gross, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN billable_dbus_post_promo END) AS h_bill FROM v_post_promo_simulation v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m)
SELECT today AS cost_today_usd, post AS cost_post_promo_usd, post / NULLIF(today, 0) AS multiplier,
       above / NULLIF(humans, 0) AS pct_above, 1 - h_bill / NULLIF(h_gross, 0) AS allowance_absorbed FROM s

datasets.name: ds_p3_obs
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
s AS (SELECT SUM(cost_today_usd) AS today, SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS post, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' THEN cost_post_promo_usd END) AS sp_post, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN identities END) AS humans, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN humans_above_allowance END) AS above, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN gross_dbus END) AS h_gross, SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'HUMANO' THEN billable_dbus_post_promo END) AS h_bill FROM v_post_promo_simulation v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m)
,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('Em ', date_format(ref.m, 'MM/yyyy'), ', o LLM do Genie custou ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(s.today AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ' com as regras atuais. Com as regras de fev/2027, o mesmo uso custaria ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(s.post AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ' (', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(s.post / s.today AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), 'x).') AS observacao FROM s CROSS JOIN ref
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ordem, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(s.above AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' de ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(s.humans AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' usuários humanos (', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (s.above / s.humans) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ') passaram da franquia de 150 DBUs no mês. Para os demais, o custo de LLM seria zero.') AS observacao FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat('A franquia por usuário absorve ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (1 - s.h_bill / s.h_gross) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' dos DBUs consumidos por pessoas. O restante (', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(s.h_bill AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs) vem de quem passa de 150 DBUs.') AS observacao FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ordem, concat('Service principals respondem por ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (s.sp_post / s.post) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' do custo de LLM pós-promoção. Todo DBU de SP é cobrado.') AS observacao FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ordem, 'Este valor ainda não inclui a computação do SQL warehouse (Passo 5) nem crescimento (Passo 7): é o run-rate de LLM a partir de fev/2027.' AS observacao FROM s),
wrapped AS (SELECT ordem, observacao, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(concat('• ', observacao), '(.{1,88})(\\s+|$)', '$1\n   '), '\n   $', '') AS texto FROM o WHERE observacao IS NOT NULL),
lines_ AS (SELECT *, size(split(texto, '\\n')) AS n_lines FROM wrapped)
SELECT ordem, observacao, texto, (COALESCE(SUM(n_lines) OVER (ORDER BY ordem ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) * 19
       + (ordem - 1) * 10) AS y_px
FROM lines_ ORDER BY ordem

datasets.name: ds_p4_persona
queryLines:
SELECT month, persona, users, p50_dbus, p90_dbus, avg_dbus, billable_dbus_post_promo, cost_post_promo_usd, users_within_free
FROM v_persona_stats WHERE month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) AND month <= (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY month, persona

datasets.name: ds_p4_persona_ref
datasets.displayName: Passo 4 — personas no mês de referência
queryLines:
SELECT persona, users, p50_dbus, p90_dbus, avg_dbus, users_within_free, cost_post_promo_usd,
       cost_post_promo_usd / users AS cost_per_user_usd
FROM v_persona_stats WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY persona

datasets.name: ds_p4_band
queryLines:
SELECT dbu_band, persona, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS cost_post_promo_usd
FROM v_user_persona_month WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY dbu_band

datasets.name: ds_p4_top
queryLines:
SELECT i.run_as AS identity, i.identity_type, COALESCE(p.persona, 'Service principal') AS persona,
       i.full_rate_dbus, i.agents_dbus, i.one_dbus, i.code_dbus, i.billable_dbus_post_promo, i.cost_post_promo_usd
FROM v_identity_month i LEFT JOIN v_user_persona_month p ON p.month = i.month AND p.run_as = i.run_as
WHERE i.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY i.cost_post_promo_usd DESC LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_p4_kpi
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
h AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m WHERE v.identity_type = 'HUMANO'),
pc AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.5) AS p50, PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.9) AS p90, PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.99) AS p99, MAX(full_rate_dbus) AS mx, COUNT(*) AS n FROM h),
r AS (SELECT cost_post_promo_usd AS c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cost_post_promo_usd DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM h),
conc AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= n * 0.1 THEN c END) / SUM(c) AS top10pct, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 20 THEN c END) / SUM(c) AS top20 FROM r),
ps AS (SELECT max_by(persona, cost_post_promo_usd) AS top_persona, MAX(cost_post_promo_usd) AS top_cost, SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS tot, SUM(CASE WHEN persona LIKE '4-%' THEN users END) AS devs, SUM(CASE WHEN persona LIKE '1-%' THEN users END) AS beginners FROM v_persona_stats v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m)
SELECT pc.p50 AS p50_dbus, pc.p90 AS p90_dbus, pc.p99 AS p99_dbus, conc.top10pct FROM pc CROSS JOIN conc

datasets.name: ds_p4_obs
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
h AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m WHERE v.identity_type = 'HUMANO'),
pc AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.5) AS p50, PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.9) AS p90, PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.99) AS p99, MAX(full_rate_dbus) AS mx, COUNT(*) AS n FROM h),
r AS (SELECT cost_post_promo_usd AS c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cost_post_promo_usd DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM h),
conc AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= n * 0.1 THEN c END) / SUM(c) AS top10pct, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 20 THEN c END) / SUM(c) AS top20 FROM r),
ps AS (SELECT max_by(persona, cost_post_promo_usd) AS top_persona, MAX(cost_post_promo_usd) AS top_cost, SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS tot, SUM(CASE WHEN persona LIKE '4-%' THEN users END) AS devs, SUM(CASE WHEN persona LIKE '1-%' THEN users END) AS beginners FROM v_persona_stats v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m)
,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('Em ', date_format(ref.m, 'MM/yyyy'), ', o usuário mediano (p50) consumiu ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(pc.p50 AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs; p90 = ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(pc.p90 AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ', p99 = ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(pc.p99 AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' e o maior consumo individual = ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(pc.mx AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs. Compare com a franquia de 150 DBUs.') AS observacao FROM pc CROSS JOIN ref
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ordem, concat('Os 10% de usuários que mais consomem concentram ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (conc.top10pct) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' do custo de LLM pós-promoção, e os 20 maiores, ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (conc.top20) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), '. Por isso a franquia deve ser aplicada por usuário: médias enganam.') AS observacao FROM conc
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat('A persona com maior custo é ', substr(ps.top_persona, 3), ': ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(ps.top_cost AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ' (', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (ps.top_cost / ps.tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' do custo de LLM de humanos).') AS observacao FROM ps
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ordem, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(ps.beginners AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' iniciantes ficam dentro da franquia (custo de LLM zero). ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(ps.devs AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' usuários são predominantemente Genie Code: a partir de fev/2027 eles dividem a mesma franquia com Agents e One.') AS observacao FROM ps
UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ordem, 'Próximo passo: confirmar com cada área se o uso dos top 20 abaixo é legítimo e recorrente antes de projetá-lo no Passo 7.' AS observacao FROM ps),
wrapped AS (SELECT ordem, observacao, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(concat('• ', observacao), '(.{1,88})(\\s+|$)', '$1\n   '), '\n   $', '') AS texto FROM o WHERE observacao IS NOT NULL),
lines_ AS (SELECT *, size(split(texto, '\\n')) AS n_lines FROM wrapped)
SELECT ordem, observacao, texto, (COALESCE(SUM(n_lines) OVER (ORDER BY ordem ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) * 19
       + (ordem - 1) * 10) AS y_px
FROM lines_ ORDER BY ordem

datasets.name: ds_p5_trend
queryLines:
SELECT month, '1. LLM (regras pós-promoção)' AS component, human_llm_post_promo_usd + sp_llm_post_promo_usd AS usd
FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month AND month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components)
UNION ALL SELECT month, '2. SQL warehouse atribuído ao Genie', genie_warehouse_usd
FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month AND month > (SELECT MIN(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components) ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_p5_top
queryLines:
SELECT agent_name, warehouse_name, attributed_net_cost_usd FROM v_warehouse_attribution
WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AND genie_space_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY attributed_net_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_p5_wh
queryLines:
WITH w AS (SELECT warehouse_id, MAX(warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN share_of_warehouse ELSE 0 END) AS genie_share, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN queries ELSE 0 END) AS genie_queries, COUNT(DISTINCT genie_space_id) AS agents, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN attributed_net_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS genie_cost_usd, SUM(attributed_net_cost_usd) AS warehouse_cost_usd FROM v_warehouse_attribution WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) GROUP BY warehouse_id)
SELECT warehouse_name, CASE WHEN genie_share >= 0.95 THEN 'Dedicado ao Genie (≥ 95%)' WHEN genie_share >= 0.5 THEN 'Majoritariamente Genie'
       ELSE 'Compartilhado (< 50% Genie)' END AS wh_type, agents, genie_queries, genie_share, genie_cost_usd, warehouse_cost_usd
FROM w ORDER BY genie_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 50

datasets.name: ds_p5_kpi
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
w AS (SELECT warehouse_id, MAX(warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN share_of_warehouse ELSE 0 END) AS genie_share, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN queries ELSE 0 END) AS genie_queries, COUNT(DISTINCT genie_space_id) AS agents, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN attributed_net_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS genie_cost_usd, SUM(attributed_net_cost_usd) AS warehouse_cost_usd FROM v_warehouse_attribution WHERE month = (SELECT m FROM ref) GROUP BY warehouse_id),
c AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_monthly_cost_components v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),
cp AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_monthly_cost_components v JOIN ref ON v.month = add_months(ref.m, -1)),
t AS (SELECT max_by(agent_name, attributed_net_cost_usd) AS agent, MAX(attributed_net_cost_usd) AS cost FROM v_warehouse_attribution v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m WHERE genie_space_id IS NOT NULL),
k AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT_IF(genie_share >= 0.95) AS dedicated, COUNT_IF(genie_share < 0.5) AS shared FROM w)
SELECT c.genie_warehouse_usd, c.genie_warehouse_usd / NULLIF(c.total_post_promo_usd, 0) AS wh_share, k.n AS warehouses, k.dedicated
FROM c CROSS JOIN k

datasets.name: ds_p5_obs
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
w AS (SELECT warehouse_id, MAX(warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN share_of_warehouse ELSE 0 END) AS genie_share, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN queries ELSE 0 END) AS genie_queries, COUNT(DISTINCT genie_space_id) AS agents, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN attributed_net_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS genie_cost_usd, SUM(attributed_net_cost_usd) AS warehouse_cost_usd FROM v_warehouse_attribution WHERE month = (SELECT m FROM ref) GROUP BY warehouse_id),
c AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_monthly_cost_components v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),
cp AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_monthly_cost_components v JOIN ref ON v.month = add_months(ref.m, -1)),
t AS (SELECT max_by(agent_name, attributed_net_cost_usd) AS agent, MAX(attributed_net_cost_usd) AS cost FROM v_warehouse_attribution v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m WHERE genie_space_id IS NOT NULL),
k AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT_IF(genie_share >= 0.95) AS dedicated, COUNT_IF(genie_share < 0.5) AS shared FROM w)
,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('Em ', date_format(ref.m, 'MM/yyyy'), ', a computação SQL atribuída aos Genie Agents custou ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(c.genie_warehouse_usd AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ', ou ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (c.genie_warehouse_usd / c.total_post_promo_usd) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' do custo total pós-promoção. Esse valor não entra no budget do Genie.') AS observacao FROM c CROSS JOIN ref
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ordem, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(k.n AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' warehouses executaram queries do Genie: ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(k.dedicated AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' são praticamente dedicados (≥ 95% do tempo de task) e ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(k.shared AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' são compartilhados (< 50%). Em warehouses compartilhados o rateio é uma estimativa.') AS observacao FROM k
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat('O Genie Agent com maior custo de warehouse no mês é ', COALESCE(t.agent, 'n/d'), ' (', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(t.cost AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ').') AS observacao FROM t
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ordem, concat('Variação do custo de warehouse do Genie em relação ao mês anterior: ', concat(CASE WHEN (c.genie_warehouse_usd / cp.genie_warehouse_usd - 1) >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (c.genie_warehouse_usd / cp.genie_warehouse_usd - 1) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%')), '.') AS observacao FROM c CROSS JOIN cp
UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ordem, 'Ociosidade e auto-stop não entram no rateio proporcional. Para atribuição exata, use um warehouse serverless dedicado por área para os Genie Agents de produção.' AS observacao FROM c),
wrapped AS (SELECT ordem, observacao, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(concat('• ', observacao), '(.{1,88})(\\s+|$)', '$1\n   '), '\n   $', '') AS texto FROM o WHERE observacao IS NOT NULL),
lines_ AS (SELECT *, size(split(texto, '\\n')) AS n_lines FROM wrapped)
SELECT ordem, observacao, texto, (COALESCE(SUM(n_lines) OVER (ORDER BY ordem ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) * 19
       + (ordem - 1) * 10) AS y_px
FROM lines_ ORDER BY ordem

datasets.name: ds_p6_kpi
queryLines:

u AS (SELECT SUM(questions) AS questions, COUNT(*) AS agents, SUM(agent_mode_questions) AS am, MAX(llm_cost_per_question_usd) AS llm_q, SUM(warehouse_net_cost_usd) AS wh FROM v_unit_costs v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),

datasets.name: ds_p7_tot
queryLines:
SELECT f.scenario, MIN(f.scenario_order) AS scenario_order, SUM(f.human_llm_usd) AS human_llm_usd, SUM(f.sp_llm_usd) AS sp_llm_usd,
       SUM(f.genie_warehouse_usd) AS genie_warehouse_usd, SUM(f.new_use_cases_usd) AS new_use_cases_usd,

datasets.name: ds_p7_obs
queryLines:
WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Conservador' THEN total_with_headroom_usd END) AS cons, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Base' THEN total_with_headroom_usd END) AS base, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Agressivo' THEN total_with_headroom_usd END) AS aggr, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Base' THEN human_llm_usd END) AS b_h, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Base' THEN sp_llm_usd END) AS b_sp, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Base' THEN genie_warehouse_usd END) AS b_wh, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Base' THEN new_use_cases_usd END) AS b_new, SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Base' THEN total_usd END) AS b_tot, MAX(headroom) AS headroom FROM v_fy_forecast_total),
m AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN in_promo THEN total_usd END) AS promo_m, min_by(total_usd, CASE WHEN in_promo THEN NULL ELSE month END) AS first_paid, COUNT_IF(NOT in_promo) AS paid_months FROM v_fy_forecast_total WHERE scenario = 'Base'),
b AS (SELECT * FROM v_forecast_baseline)
,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('Previsão do ano fiscal (com margem de ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (t.headroom) AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), '): Conservador ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(t.cons AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ' · Base ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(t.base AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ' · Agressivo ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(t.aggr AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), '.') São ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(m.paid_months AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' meses cobrados com as novas regras.') AS observacao FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat('Composição do cenário Base no ano: LLM de humanos ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (t.b_h / t.b_tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ', LLM de service principals ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (t.b_sp / t.b_tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ', SQL warehouse ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (t.b_wh / t.b_tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' e novos casos de uso ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (t.b_new / t.b_tot) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), '.') datasets.displayName: Passo 8 — analogia por volume de perguntas
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
u AS (SELECT SUM(questions) AS questions, MAX(llm_cost_per_question_usd) AS llm_q, SUM(warehouse_net_cost_usd) AS wh FROM v_unit_costs v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),
cpq AS (SELECT u.llm_q + u.wh / NULLIF(u.questions, 0) AS cost_per_question_usd FROM u),
pm AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(NOT in_promo) AS paid_months FROM v_fy_forecast_total WHERE scenario = 'Base'),
v AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES (1000), (5000), (10000), (50000) AS t(questions_per_month))
SELECT v.questions_per_month, cpq.cost_per_question_usd, v.questions_per_month * cpq.cost_per_question_usd AS monthly_usd,
       v.questions_per_month * cpq.cost_per_question_usd * pm.paid_months AS fy_usd
FROM v CROSS JOIN cpq CROSS JOIN pm ORDER BY v.questions_per_month

datasets.name: ds_p8_persona
queryLines:
WITH pm AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(NOT in_promo) AS paid_months FROM v_fy_forecast_total WHERE scenario = 'Base')

       100 * cost_post_promo_usd / users AS monthly_100_users_usd, 100 * cost_post_promo_usd / users * pm.paid_months AS fy_100_users_usd
FROM v_persona_stats CROSS JOIN pm WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) ORDER BY persona

datasets.name: ds_p9_kpi
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(month) FROM v_monthly_cost_components WHERE is_complete_month) AS m),
p AS (SELECT * FROM v_price),
h AS (SELECT v.* FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m WHERE v.identity_type = 'HUMANO'),
pc AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.9) AS p90, PERCENTILE_APPROX(full_rate_dbus, 0.99) AS p99, COUNT(*) AS n FROM h),
f AS (SELECT (human_llm_usd + sp_llm_usd) / NULLIF(1 - p.contract_discount_srti, 0) AS feb_llm_list_usd FROM v_fy_forecast_total CROSS JOIN p WHERE scenario = 'Base' AND NOT in_promo ORDER BY month LIMIT 1),
th AS (SELECT GREATEST(pc.p90 - p.free_allowance_dbus, 0) * p.srti_list_price * (1 + p.addon_uplift) AS user_limit_usd, GREATEST(pc.p99 - p.free_allowance_dbus, 0) * p.srti_list_price * (1 + p.addon_uplift) AS power_limit_usd, pc.p90, pc.p99, pc.n FROM pc CROSS JOIN p),
ab AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(h.full_rate_dbus > th.p90) AS above_default, COUNT_IF(h.full_rate_dbus > th.p99) AS above_power FROM h CROSS JOIN th),
sp AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' THEN cost_post_promo_usd END) / SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS sp_share, COUNT_IF(identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' AND cost_post_promo_usd > 0) AS sps FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),
wsh AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS shared FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(CASE WHEN genie_space_id IS NOT NULL THEN share_of_warehouse ELSE 0 END) AS gs FROM v_warehouse_attribution v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m GROUP BY warehouse_id) WHERE gs < 0.5)
SELECT f.feb_llm_list_usd AS pool_100_usd, 0.8 * f.feb_llm_list_usd AS pool_80_usd, th.user_limit_usd, th.power_limit_usd
FROM f CROSS JOIN th

datasets.name: ds_p9_persona
queryLines:
WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM v_price)

ab AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(h.full_rate_dbus > th.p90) AS above_default, COUNT_IF(h.full_rate_dbus > th.p99) AS above_power FROM h CROSS JOIN th),
sp AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' THEN cost_post_promo_usd END) / SUM(cost_post_promo_usd) AS sp_share, COUNT_IF(identity_type = 'SERVICE_PRINCIPAL' AND cost_post_promo_usd > 0) AS sps FROM v_identity_month v JOIN ref ON v.month = ref.m),

,
o AS (SELECT 1 AS ordem, concat('Pool mensal sugerido para o budget do Genie (preço de lista, LLM do cenário Base em fev/2027): ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(f.feb_llm_list_usd AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), '. Alertas por e-mail/webhook em 80% (', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(0.8 * f.feb_llm_list_usd AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), ') e 100%, sem bloqueio.') AS observacao FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ordem, concat('Limite padrão por usuário sugerido: ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(th.user_limit_usd AS DOUBLE), 2), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), '/mês acima da franquia (p90 = ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(th.p90 AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs), com bloqueio. Grupo genie-power-users: ', concat('US$ ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(th.power_limit_usd AS DOUBLE), 2), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d')), '/mês (p99 = ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(th.p99 AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' DBUs).') AS observacao FROM th
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ordem, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(ab.above_default AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' de ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(th.n AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' usuários passariam do limite padrão no mês de referência, e ', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(ab.above_power AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' passariam do limite de power users. Esses são os candidatos ao grupo com override e ao processo de aprovação.') AS observacao FROM ab CROSS JOIN th
UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ordem, concat('Service principals somam ', concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(100 * (sp.sp_share) AS DOUBLE), 1), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), '%'), ' do custo de LLM pós-promoção (', COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(sp.sps AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' SPs com custo). Para apps voltadas a usuários, prefira OBO: cada usuário usa a própria franquia e a atribuição fica por pessoa.') AS observacao FROM sp
UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ordem, concat(COALESCE(translate(format_number(CAST(wsh.shared AS DOUBLE), 0), ',.', '.,'), 'n/d'), ' warehouses compartilhados (< 50% Genie) executam queries do Genie. Budgets do Genie não cobrem warehouse: use budgets de DBSQL e tags nos warehouses, de preferência dedicados por área.') AS observacao FROM wsh),

       + (ordem - 1) * 10) AS y_px
FROM lines_ ORDER BY ordem

# Guia de Previsão de Gastos com Genie — passo a passo (Passos 1 a 10)
Este dashboard segue, aba por aba, o **Guia de Previsão de Gastos com Genie (Próximo Ano Fiscal)** (`docs/GUIA_PREVISAO_GENIE_ptBR.md`). Cada aba corresponde a um passo do guia e traz o **objetivo**, um quadro **Como ler**, as **observações calculadas a partir dos dados** e os gráficos que sustentam cada conclusão. Todos os números vêm das system tables do próprio workspace: nenhum dado é simulado.

### O que muda em 01/02/2027
| Componente | Até 31/01/2027 | A partir de 01/02/2027 |
|---|---|---|
| Genie Agents e Genie One (pessoas) | Gratuito (`GENIE_FREE_USAGE`) | Cobrado acima da franquia |
| Genie Code | Cobrado acima da franquia, com 25% de desconto | Cobrado acima da franquia, sem desconto |
| Service principals | Sempre cobrado, sem franquia | Sempre cobrado, sem franquia |
| Franquia | 150 DBUs/usuário/mês, só Genie Code consome | 150 DBUs/usuário/mês **compartilhados** por Code, One e Agents |
| SQL warehouse | Cobrado (DBSQL) | Cobrado (DBSQL), fora do budget do Genie |

### Roteiro das abas
1. **SKU e preço**: quanto custa um DBU
2. **Linha de base**: quanto consumimos hoje
3. **Reprecificar**: o mesmo uso com as regras de fev/2027
4. **Personas**: quem consome
5. **SQL warehouse**: o custo fora do LLM
6. **Custos unitários**: custo por pergunta e por usuário
7. **Projeção FY**: cenários Conservador, Base e Agressivo
8. **Novos casos de uso**: o que ainda não tem histórico
9. **Controles**: budgets antes de 01/02/2027
10. **Operacionalizar**: acompanhamento mensal

_Mês de referência = último mês completo. O primeiro mês do histórico (julho/2026, a partir de 20/07) é parcial e fica fora dos gráficos mensais. Valores em US$ com o desconto contratual e os adicionais configurados em `forecast_assumptions` (Passo 1). Para a visão consolidada por tema, use o dashboard **Genie FinOps & Previsão FY2027**._

## Passo 1 — Identificar o SKU e o preço unitário
**Objetivo:** descobrir em qual SKU (Serverless Real-Time Inference, SRTI) o Genie será cobrado e qual preço por DBU usar na previsão.  
_Guia: seção 3 · ← Introdução · Passo 2 →_

### 📖 Como ler esta aba
- O preço vem de `system.billing.list_prices`, nunca de um valor fixo.
- **P_net = P_list × (1 − desconto contratual)**. O desconto não está nas system tables: vem do time comercial.
- Se houver adicional de plataforma (ex.: ESC), ele é aplicado depois do desconto.
- Esse preço é usado em todos os passos seguintes.

## Passo 5 — Atribuir a computação do SQL warehouse ao Genie
**Objetivo:** somar o custo do SQL warehouse que executa as queries geradas pelo Genie, que fica fora da linha de LLM e do budget do Genie.

### 📖 Como ler esta aba
- Queries de Genie Agents são identificadas por `query_source.genie_space_id` em `system.query.history`.
- O custo do warehouse é **rateado pelo tempo de task** entre Genie e outras cargas.
- Warehouse **dedicado** ao Genie = atribuição exata (recomendado).
- Genie One não traz `genie_space_id`: aparece como não-Genie.

**Objetivo:** transformar custo em indicadores de negócio (custo por pergunta e por usuário ativo) para projetar a partir de usuários, Agents e perguntas.

- **Custo por pergunta** = LLM por pergunta + warehouse por pergunta.
- **Custo por usuário ativo** = (LLM cobrável + warehouse) ÷ usuários ativos.
- Custo por pergunta alto aponta Agent mode intenso, instruções ou metadados fracos ou warehouse grande demais.
